question: Does evidence-bearing correspondence change later real Work with observable receiver effort and an independently chosen revision?
authority: INFORMATION_ONLY; registration grants no provider, message, delegation or foreign Work authority
enrollment: Record actual identity, Work, role, session/context, observed model/provider provenance where available, date and authorization before participation; never substitute synthetic role aliases for independent actors
inputs: Opportunistic current letters on actual authorized project Work; no seeded mail or symbolic replacement Work
baseline: Receiver declares comparable observation scope, effort boundary and success/failure criterion before review or revision; absent baseline remains UNKNOWN
required_behavior: explicit evidence recheck and receiver decision
fresh successor discovery without predecessor chat
successor executes different real Work and verifies its own result
success_boundary: At most one traceable field improvement; a claimed effort reduction requires the registered comparable baseline
failure_boundary: No eligible letter, missing independent role, missing receiver measurement, no independently chosen revision or no successor execution prevents field-improvement success
stop: Six actual entries without an eligible letter: EMPTY_OBSERVATIONS; unavailable roles remain NOT_RUN
